sections.content: WHERE filters rows before results return: =, !=, <, >, <=, >=, BETWEEN, IN, LIKE, IS NULL. Combine with AND/OR/NOT and parentheses for precedence.
LIKE uses % (any chars) and _ (one char) wildcards; IS NULL checks missing values — never use = NULL.
Key points: filter on indexed columns for speed, string comparisons are often case-insensitive in MySQL but sensitive in PostgreSQL.

sections.codeExample:
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE age >= 18 AND city = 'Paris';
